title: Mod manifests
description:
Check each mod's manifest and its dependencies before loading anything.

```
mod "better-swords" 1.2 needs core >= 1.0: ok
mod "magic-plus" needs "spells-lib": missing -> skipped
mod "old-ui" needs core >= 3.0 (you have 2.1) -> skipped
loaded 1 of 3
```
hints: Compare versions as pairs: `std::tie(a.major, a.minor) >= std::tie(b.major, b.minor)` (lesson 13.01).
Add each loaded mod to `available`, so later mods can depend on it.
requirements: A manifest has an id, a version and a list of `(dependency, minimum version)`.
A mod loads only if every dependency is present (the game itself counts as `core`) with a high enough version.
Print a reason for every mod that is skipped.
stretch: Sort mods so dependencies load first (the topological sort from milestone 3).
